headline.purpose: Landing h1 on the paper strip and the final call.

title.purpose: Section notes, sheet titles, name tag, handwritten name field.

title-sm.purpose: Icebreaker question, chore steps, checklist title.

lead.purpose: Hero sub and section-note paragraphs, about 36ch.

shadows.name: shadow-paper
shadows.purpose: Paper plane: every card, sheet, sticky, strip and postcard. The only :root shadow token.

shadows.name: magnet-rest
shadows.purpose: Magnet plane at rest. Written on each magnet rule so --rim resolves per magnet, never at :root.

shadows.name: magnet-hover
shadows.purpose: Magnet hover, with translateY(-1px) and brightness(1.06).

shadows.name: magnet-pressed
shadows.purpose: Pressed, selected and busy: snapped into the door.

shadows.name: magnet-small
shadows.purpose: Pin magnets, language magnets, filled code tiles.

shadows.name: letter-rim
shadows.purpose: text-shadow for alphabet magnet letters. The cast deepens to 0.24em 0.22em when a letter is lifted.

shadows.name: door-freezer-inset
shadows.purpose: Door plane: structure only, no cast shadow.

shadows.name: handle
shadows.purpose: Chrome handle. The x offsets negate under [dir=rtl].

shadows.name: focus-ring-field
shadows.purpose: Text field focus, paired with a cobalt border.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Magnet press and hover (140ms), card deal (520ms), fridge shake (0.5s), loading hop (900ms).

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Letter lift scale (160ms), code tile fill (160ms), joke card straighten (220ms).

motion.name: magnet-press
motion.purpose: Transform and box-shadow on every magnet.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition durations.

components.name: Tomato Magnet
components.description: The go-forward action, one per viewport. Snaps into the door on press.
components.css: .ds-magnet-tomato { --rim: var(--tomato-rim, #9e2414); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--tomato, #d63a26); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-display, 'Baloo Bhaijaan 2 Variable', 'Baloo Bhaijaan 2', ui-rounded, sans-serif); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; padding: 0.7rem 1.3rem; font-size: 1.05rem; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--rim), 0 9px 14px -4px rgb(36 48 10 / 0.5); transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 140ms; } .ds-magnet-tomato:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 var(--rim), 0 12px 16px -4px rgb(36 48 10 / 0.5); } .ds-magnet-tomato:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--rim), 0 3px 5px -2px rgb(36 48 10 / 0.45); } .ds-magnet-tomato:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--cobalt, #2340c4); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Every circloo surface is the door of a shared fridge. The ground is a drenched pistachio enamel that fills the viewport edge to edge. A freezer compartment sits on top, separated by a groove, and a black kick plate closes the bottom. A rubber seal and a full-length chrome handle run down the inline-end edge. Anything the circle says or does is stuck to this door: words go on paper (white index cards, sticky notes, kraft strips, postcards, name tags), and anything you can press is a chunky plastic magnet. The landing page and the signed-in app share one world. The app's forms are sheets of paper pinned to the same door.

The density is relaxed and physical. Papers sit slightly crooked, magnets stand proud of the door and snap flat when pressed, and the alphabet magnets that spell the wordmark can be dragged. The palette has four magnet colours (tomato, cobalt, sunflower, ink) against the enamel and the paper. Type comes in two voices: a round, heavy display face that looks like moulded plastic letters, and a calm geometric text face for reading.

The world is built for four languages, including Arabic in RTL. The door mirrors: the handle and seal move to the left edge, sticky-note curls flip corners, and the display face covers Arabic natively.
keyCharacteristics: Pistachio enamel ground everywhere. No white page and no neutral grey canvas.
Three depth planes: door (flat, inset grooves only), paper (soft lift), magnet (a coloured plastic rim plus a cast shadow).
Paper sits at a small tilt (between -4deg and +4deg). Every heading is set on paper, never straight on the enamel.
Buttons and links that act are magnets, and pressing one snaps it into the door.
Baloo Bhaijaan 2 for display (Latin and Arabic), Rubik for text. Both are self-hosted.
Logical properties throughout, with explicit `[dir='rtl']` mirrors for every asymmetric detail.

rules.name: The Four Plastics Rule
rules.body: Magnets come only in tomato, cobalt, sunflower, ink and white paper, each with its own darker rim. A new magnet colour needs a design decision, not a one-off hex.

rules.name: The One Tomato Rule
rules.body: Each viewport has one tomato action, and it is the step forward. Secondary actions are paper, ink or sunflower magnets, or an underlined text link.

rules.name: The Enamel Is Not Paper Rule
rules.body: Text set straight on the enamel uses ink or ink-soft. Grey text tones made for paper (ink-on-paper-soft) never go on the door.

rules.name: The Arabic Display Rule
rules.body: Under `:lang(ar)`, display headings drop the -0.01em tracking to 0 and open line height to 1.25 for dots and marks. Never uppercase or letter-space Arabic.

rules.name: The Magnet Word Stays LTR Rule
rules.body: The "circloo" magnet wordmark is pinned `direction: ltr` in every locale. It is a brand object, not running text.

rules.name: The Handle Lane Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the door may sit in the inline-end `handle-space`. The handle runs from 9rem down for min(62vh, 34rem) and must stay clear.

rules.name: The Own-Rim Rule
rules.body: A magnet's shadow is written on the magnet's own rule, because it reads that magnet's `--rim`. A `:root` shadow token would resolve `--rim` at the root and break every colour variant. Only the paper shadow lives at `:root`.

rules.name: The Three Planes Rule
rules.body: Rims belong only to magnets. Paper gets `--shadow-paper` and never a solid offset. The door gets no cast shadow at all. If an element has a rim, it must be pressable or be a magnet holding something.

rules.name: The Snap Rule
rules.body: Press feedback is physical: the magnet drops 2 to 3px and its rim collapses to 1px over 140ms on `--ease-out`. Selected states (language) and busy states use the same snapped-in pose.

dos: **Do** set every heading on paper held by a pin magnet. Supporting paragraphs may sit on the enamel in ink or ink-soft.
**Do** write magnet shadows on the magnet's own rule using its `--rim`, and keep `--shadow-paper` as the only shared shadow token.
**Do** give each paper a small, different tilt between -4deg and +4deg. Keep controls upright relative to their paper.

**Do** use logical properties (`inset-inline-*`, `padding-inline-*`, `border-block-*`) and add a `[dir='rtl']` mirror for every asymmetric detail: curled corners, handle shadow, pin translate, margin-note rotation, directional icons.
**Do** pass every dynamic position or value through CSS custom properties set from script (`setProperty`). The CSP forbids inline style attributes.
**Do** pair a mood with both an icon and a word. Mood is never colour alone.
**Do** use Lucide SVG icons at stroke 2.25 to 2.5, decorative and `aria-hidden` beside a visible label.
**Do** honour reduced motion: the global rule collapses animations and transitions to 0.01ms, and the shake, deal and hop animations depend on it.
donts: **Don't** give paper a solid offset shadow or give the door a cast shadow. Rims are for magnets only.
**Don't** declare a magnet shadow token at `:root`. It resolves `--rim` at the root and breaks every colour variant.
**Don't** introduce a fifth magnet colour or a one-off button hex. Use tomato, cobalt, sunflower, ink or paper.
**Don't** put more than one tomato action in a viewport.
**Don't** set display type in Rubik or a system face. Don't set body copy in Baloo Bhaijaan 2.
**Don't** add small labels or eyebrows above headings. The heading on its pinned paper is the hierarchy.
**Don't** use emoji or text glyphs as icons.
**Don't** place content in the handle lane at the inline-end edge, or use physical left/right properties.
**Don't** apply negative tracking, uppercase or letter-spacing to Arabic text.
